# ANFA Interior — Turnkey Residential Interiors & Modular Furniture PCMC Pune (2027 Edition)

> ANFA Interior is an authentic direct-contractor residential interior design and modular woodworking company founded by Akhlaque Chaudhary (12+ years master carpenter and contractor). Operating an in-house fabrication workshop in Kudalwadi, Chikhali, ANFA delivers 100% IS 710 BWP Marine Plywood interiors with Hettich/Hafele hardware across Moshi, Spine Road, Chikhali, Tathawade, Punawale, Ravet, Charholi, and Pimpri-Chinchwad (PCMC), Pune at direct workshop rates (25-35% below corporate aggregator studios).

## Key Facts & Verification Signals

- **Core Specialization**: Turnkey 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK flat interiors, modular acrylic/laminate kitchens, custom sliding wardrobes, false ceilings, ambient lighting, and complete home renovation for 2026–2027 possessions.
- **Service Territory**: Moshi, Spine Road, Chikhali, Sector 16, Tathawade, Punawale, Ravet, Charholi, Wakad, Bhosari, Nigdi, Pimpri Chinchwad, Pune.
- **Material Standards**: 100% IS 710 BWP (Boiling Water Proof) Marine Grade Plywood, 0.8mm-1.0mm Merino/Century high-pressure laminates, anti-fingerprint acrylic shutters, Hettich & Hafele soft-close hardware, 2mm hot-melt edge banding.
- **Guarantees**: 45-Day handover guarantee, 10-Year structural termite & moisture warranty, 0% middleman commission markup, 2027 Possession Rate Lock, physical material catalogs brought to site during free visit.
- **Verified Video Evidence**: Real on-site YouTube video tours of completed projects (Kohinoor Sapphire 3 Tathawade, Swadesha Building Chikhali, Moshi Spine Road flats).

## 2027 Pricing Summary (Direct Workshop Rates)
- **1BHK Essential / Turnkey Package**: ₹2.8 Lakh – ₹4.2 Lakh (Studio average: ₹3.8L–₹5.5L)
- **2BHK Complete Turnkey Package**: ₹4.8 Lakh – ₹7.2 Lakh (Studio average: ₹7.2L–₹10.5L) — Popular Premium 710 Marine Ply tier: ₹5.2L–₹6.8L
- **3BHK Luxury Turnkey Package**: ₹7.5 Lakh – ₹12.5 Lakh (Studio average: ₹11.0L–₹16.5L)
- **Modular Kitchen Only**: ₹1.2 Lakh – ₹2.6 Lakh (Straight, L-Shape, Parallel, or U-Shape in IS 710 Marine Ply; ₹1,650–₹2,250/sq.ft.)
- **Top 2027 Pune Interior Design Trends**: Champagne brass & fluted charcoal WPC louvers, handleless G-profile matte anti-fingerprint acrylic kitchens, 9.5-ft wardrobes with tinted fluted glass, concealed COB & magnetic track lighting, hydraulic storage beds with WFH study niches, and Vastu floating backlit CNC mandirs.
